description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka - Financial Statements for the year ended 31st December 2021 (E only)
categorisation: The gazette content contains the independent auditor's report and financial statements for The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka, which is a professional body rather than a government entity. This does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It represents financial reporting by a professional institute, making it fall under Miscellaneous administrative matters.
